name: 竖屏短剧剧本
description: 从一句故事梗概写出竖屏短剧：人物 → 分集大纲 → 逐集剧本 → 检查集数、时长和每集的钩子。 / Write a vertical short drama from a one-line premise: characters → episode outline → full scripts → check episode count, length and each episode's hook.

premise.description: 一句话梗概，例如：被裁员的程序员回老家开面馆，前老板来应聘 / One-line premise

genre.description: 类型，例如：都市逆袭、甜宠、悬疑 / Genre, e.g. underdog comeback, romance, mystery

episodeSeconds.description: 每集大约几秒 / About how many seconds per episode

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English / Output language: zh or en

stages.name: 人物
stages.description: 3 到 5 个主要人物：身份、想要什么、藏着什么。 / 3 to 5 main characters: who they are, what they want, what they hide.

stages.name: 分集大纲
stages.description: 每集的开头钩子、主要冲突、反转和结尾悬念。 / Each episode's opening hook, conflict, twist and cliffhanger.

stages.name: 剧本
stages.description: 逐集写场景、动作和台词，竖屏拍摄，节奏要快。 / Write each episode's scenes, action and dialogue, shot vertically, at a fast pace.

stages.name: 检查
stages.description: 集数对不对、按台词估算的时长、哪个人物没出场、哪集没写结尾悬念。 / Is the episode count right, estimated length from dialogue, characters who never appear, episodes without a cliffhanger.
